task: Implement incremental pipeline-run persistence in composer, per .pi/loop-guide.md (read it first, it is the binding spec). Four pieces: (1) UpdateActive + FailInterrupted methods on pipeline.RunRepository, (2) store implementation in internal/infra/store/pipeline_repo.go with the SQL terminal-state guard, leaving the existing Update method untouched, (3) an optional persist hook on PipelineExecutor (setter, not a constructor change) called after run.Start() and after each batch's RecordStepResult loop, guarded by the run context, errors never failing the run, (4) wiring in NewPipelineService plus a FailInterrupted reaper call in cmd/composerd/main.go. Write the three contract tests the guide names exactly: TestRunRepo_UpdateActive, TestRunRepo_FailInterrupted, TestPipelineExecutor_IncrementalPersist. Update any test fakes implementing RunRepository.
rules: NEVER run ./composerd, go run ./cmd/composerd/, or any built composer binary - its startup hook AES-encrypts ~/.ssh and the keys are unrecoverable. Verification is go test / go build / go vet ONLY.
Do not change the existing RunRepo.Update method's SQL, signature, or semantics - CancelRun depends on them.
Persist errors from the incremental hook must be warn-logged and swallowed - a persistence failure must never fail a pipeline run.
No new module dependencies; stdlib + existing deps only.
Do not modify, rename, or weaken any existing test. New tests use the exact names the guide specifies.
If go commands fail inside the sandbox on a read-only build cache, export GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOMODCACHE=$(go env GOMODCACHE).
A sensor satisfied by a stub (panic("not implemented"), TODO body) is a FAILED iteration.
If you need a paragraph-long comment to justify a workaround, the code is wrong - fix the code.
